items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: We called them Jo Pierre, but his name was Jo Alexander. Dejean's brother. He played the e flat cornet.

ctx.x: Ernest Martin, yeah. He played the... He played the alto, the same instrument I played. One the smart. One the smart. And they had the Dejean's brother. We called them Jo Pierre, but his name was Jo Alexander. Dejean's brother. He played the e flat cornet. And the time you used them the e flat cornet the old.
What kind of part was the e flat cornet the old?
